spaces.access: Registered University of Melbourne staff and students only; individual swipe cards required. Unaffiliated visitors are not admitted.
spaces.jumuah: Friday prayers weekly in the Islamic Prayer Space; times vary by semester and daylight saving. Check the official schedule.

spaces.name: Music Building multi-faith room
spaces.location: Southbank, Music Building (Building 862), Room 404
spaces.access: Book the Southbank prayer/quiet room through DIBS; check the booking conditions.

notes: Musallah is about a 10-minute walk from the Parkville student precinct; iqamah times via umis.com.au. Coordinates: Wikidata Q319078 (P625), university-level point, not the prayer room.
